skills.name: Path Command Execution
skills.description: Execute individual path drawing operations on a path object by invoking discrete drawing commands such as moveTo, lineTo, quadraticCurveTo, bezierCurveTo, arcTo, arc, rect, or closePath. Use when building up a path incrementally through atomic drawing primitives.
skills.skill_body:
Invoke a single path drawing command on an active path object. Each command updates the path's internal state by adding a new segment or closing the subpath. Commands are: moveTo (reposition), lineTo (straight line), quadraticCurveTo (quadratic Bézier), bezierCurveTo (cubic Bézier), arcTo (circular arc via tangent), arc (circular arc via center), rect (rectangle), closePath (close subpath). Ensure the path object exists and is in an open state before invoking (except closePath, which closes it).

## Objective

execute single path drawing operation
## Applicable Signals

- path object is initialized and open
- caller has coordinates or parameters for the target operation
- path is being built incrementally from primitives

## Contraindications

- path is already closed (except for starting a new subpath with moveTo)
- no active path context exists
- operation is not a drawing primitive (e.g., serialization or rounding)

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Verify path object exists and is in the correct state (open for drawing, or ready for moveTo).'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Select the appropriate drawing command based on the desired segment type (line, curve, arc, rectangle, or close).'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Invoke the command with the required parameters (coordinates, control points, radius, etc.).'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': "Confirm the path object's internal state has been updated with the new segment."}

## Constraints

- path object must be created before any drawing command is invoked
- closePath must be called on an open subpath; calling it on an already-closed path is a no-op
- moveTo can be called at any time to start a new subpath
- all coordinate and parameter values must be numeric

## Cautions

- Calling closePath does not prevent further drawing; a new subpath can be started immediately after.
- arcTo and arc have different parameter signatures; arcTo uses tangent-based control, arc uses center-based control.
- Each command is atomic; there is no rollback or undo within a single path object.

## Output Contract

- Path object is updated with the new drawing command; internal state reflects the new segment. The path remains open and ready for additional commands (unless closePath was invoked, in which case the subpath is closed but the path object persists for new subpaths).
